implement_Coverage_subclass: implement a subclass of Coverage to define RPC test coverage for your gRPC framework
test_successful_unary_unary: test successful unary request unary response RPC calls in your gRPC implementation
test_successful_stream_stream: test successful stream request stream response RPC calls in your gRPC implementation
test_cancelled_unary_unary: test cancelled unary request unary response RPC calls in your gRPC implementation
test_failed_stream_stream: test failed stream request stream response RPC calls in your gRPC implementation
